review.verdict: attackable on multiple internal grounds; should not enter the curated dataset as-is

issues.problem: The number 20k appears only in the title and observation as an assertion; the record provides no DRC count, log excerpt, tool output, or screenshot to support it.
issues.correct_version: Quote the actual DRC or overflow count from the report/log, and distinguish GRT overflows from DRCs if they are not identical.

issues.claim: Congestion heatmap shows a large region at the top of the die and around the macro
issues.problem: The heatmap is named but not attached or referenced, and the affected region is described only as 'large' with no quantitative bounds; 'the macro' is unnamed.
issues.correct_version: Attach or link the heatmap, or describe the congestion region in bin-level terms and name the macro, its type, and placement.

issues.claim: GRT routing-layer adjustment of 0.45 (originally derived from other asap7 designs)
issues.problem: The origin of 0.45 is asserted without evidence; the record does not cite which designs, which file, or how the value was derived.
issues.correct_version: Cite the source of the 0.45 value or mark it explicitly as an unverified assumption.

issues.claim: Changing layer adjustment from 0.45 to 0.2 and congestion iterations to 35 let GRT complete
issues.problem: The intervention bundles two parameter changes without isolating their effects; the record does not say whether each was tried separately or whether one alone was sufficient.
issues.correct_version: Report the result of each change separately, or state clearly that only the combined change was tried and the individual contributions are unknown.

issues.claim: default 30 congestion iterations were insufficient; then 35 is presented as part of the fix
issues.problem: The narrative says increasing iterations 'was asked early on and swept, default 30,' yet later presents '35' as a chosen intervention; what the sweep covered, what it found, and why 35 specifically is chosen are not explained.
issues.correct_version: Reconcile the sweep description and explain why 35 was selected rather than 40, 50, or some other number.

issues.claim: A separate suspected cause is a global-route path 'looping around the macro' (tracked in issue #5971)
issues.problem: The looping hypothesis is introduced here but its evidence is not reproduced; it is attributed to the thread and offloaded to another issue, so its status in this episode is unclear.
issues.correct_version: Either keep the macro-loop claim out of this episode's hypothesis unless there is evidence for it here, or state explicitly that the evidence comes from #5971 and is not reproduced.

issues.claim: GRT was reported to complete / 'complete BoomTile'
issues.problem: Completion of GRT is not the same as resolution of the congestion DRCs that are the episode's subject; no post-fix DRC count is reported, so the outcome is 'GRT ran to completion,' not 'congestion resolved.'
issues.correct_version: Report a post-fix DRC/overflow count, or state explicitly that no post-fix measurement was taken and that the outcome is therefore GRT completion only.

issues.problem: The confidence is high relative to the weak evidence: no DRC count, no heatmap, no isolated experiment, no post-fix measurement, no PR, no merge status. It is unclear what the 0.8 is confidence in.
issues.correct_version: Either lower confidence to match the missing evidence, or annotate what the value refers to (e.g., confidence that the parameter suggestion was made vs. confidence that the fix is correct and sufficient).

issues.claim: issue was closed automatically as not_planned/Stale in 2026
issues.problem: An automated stale/Not_planned close is a weak signal about the fix's fate and is not clearly consistent with a narrative that the fix worked; the record does not say whether the close should be read as resolution or non-resolution.
issues.correct_version: State explicitly whether the automated close means the fix was not formally adopted, and whether the episode is a plausible fix attempt or a verified resolution.

issues.claim: layer-adjustment semantics are documented at set-global-routing-layer-adjustment; meaning of high vs low only in prose
issues.problem: The episode depends on understanding the parameter's direction, but that meaning is external to the record and only 'explained in prose' elsewhere; the episode is therefore not self-contained.
issues.correct_version: Include a one-line statement of what the parameter does and why decreasing it is expected to reduce congestion, with a reference, so the episode does not rely on external prose.

required_evidence_before_adoption: quoted pre-fix DRC or overflow count
named macro with placement or heatmap attachment
isolated or explicitly combined test of the two parameter changes
post-fix DRC/overflow count or explicit statement that none was taken
citation for the origin/semantics of the 0.45 value
clear statement of whether the stale close indicates non-adoption
